title: Mika hình thái 3 · đánh thường (đâm đao, sheet attack)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: P
segments.prompt: A chibi nine-tailed fox empress in white and gold armour with very long red hair and nine big fluffy fox tails fanned behind her, wielding a long-hafted crescent moon glaive, from her resting pose takes the glaive in both hands and levels it into the thrusting guard of the last frame, left hand supporting the shaft in front, right hand on the butt end. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the weapon action; hair, cloth and tails follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid weapon, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added flames, aura or particles.
